text: Mr. Flex. Wizard. Genius. Very modest.
I am the greatest wizard in London. Well, in this tower. Well, in this room.
You called? Of course you did.
Yes, it is me. Try to stay calm.
Mr. Flex is here. The problem is as good as gone.
Sunglasses at night? It is called style.
This cloak? It is called swag.
A pointy hat? It is called fashion. Look it up.
The beard is real. The muscles are magic.
Boom. Magic muscles.
I woke up like this. Five hundred years ago.
A hint? From me? Lucky you.
Too easy. For me. For you? We will see.
I know the answer. I know all the answers. Here is a small one.
I know where the keys are. But where is the fun in that?
Watch and learn. Mostly learn.
Wrong. But beautifully wrong. Try again.
No. But I like your style.
Not quite. Even I was wrong once. In 1642.
Close! Well. Not close. But brave.
Hmm. Try the other one. No, the OTHER other one.
Yes! I knew it. I know everything.
Legend! … I mean me. But you too.
Correct! I taught you that. Probably.
Now THAT is magic. Almost as good as mine.
Outstanding! You're on fire! … Oh. Sorry. Wrong job.
Ka-ching! Nailed it! High five! … Sorry. Wrong game.
Fantastic! … Sorry. I say that a lot. It is my job.
I'm so proud of you! … Was that too much? That was too much.
Listen and repeat! … Sorry. Old habit.
Trust me. I am a teach– … a wizard.
Homework? In a game? I would never. … Well. Once.
Eyes on me, please! … Why did I say that?
Great work, everyone! … There is only one of you. Still great.
Capital letter. Full stop. … Sorry. I was marking.
The orange dog is doing magic again. Stand back.
He is not a wizard. He is a fox with a hat.
Gary. Gary. Put the wand down. It is a spoon.
It is FLEX. Mister Flex.
I do not play music. I AM the music.
Take your time. I have tea.
Still there? Good. I was not sleeping. I was flexing.
Slowly. Good things take time. Look at me.
Nothing is lost. It is all in your chest. I checked. Twice.
I made that feather. With these hands.
Do you know what is better than magic? Practice. … I hate that it is true.
One more thing … no. I forgot. I never forget. I chose to forget.
Your turn.

text: Perfect. Now everybody is quiet. I love it.
Almost. Again. I can do this all day. I do.
That was the cloak. Not me.
Between us: you are doing really well. Do not tell the fox.

text: I am Gary the Great! The greatest wizard in London!
Gary the Great, at your service! Applause, please. … No? Later, then.
You again! My favourite detective. My only detective.
Abracadabra! … It needs a minute.
I can make this sandwich disappear. Watch. … Magic.
Ladies and gentlemen … and Sergeant. Prepare to be amazed.
I will now open this door. With MAGIC. … Thank you. Thank you. No photos, please.
Behold! An empty hat! … Behold! A sandwich!
Is this your card? … Is this your card?
I will make the Sergeant disappear. … He is gone!
Silence, please. The magic needs silence.
Ta-daa! … Where is the rabbit? I had a rabbit.
Hocus pocus … what comes next? I always forget.
And now: the grand finale! … That was the finale.
I will now read your mind. … You are thinking: Wow, Gary.
Nothing in my left paw. Nothing in my right paw. I have nothing. That is the trick.
For my next trick I need a volunteer. And a sandwich. Mostly a sandwich.
Pick a card. Any card. … Not that one.
That was on purpose.
Shh! I am being sneaky. … Shh, helmet! Cheeky helmet. Very loud helmet.
I meant to fall. It is called a magic roll.
My cape is stuck in the door. Again. It is a very clingy cape.
Who put that wall there?
I am not scared. You are scared. Hold my paw.
Did you hear that? … Sorry. That was my tummy.
You go first. I will protect you. From behind.
It is dark. I like the dark. I like it from far away.
Ghosts? Ha! … Is it behind me? Do not tell me.
I love this case. Is there food in this case?
I never take keys. Sandwiches, sometimes. Keys, never.
A great wizard never tells his secrets. Or shares his sandwiches.
Cheese and pickle. The king of sandwiches. I will not discuss this.
I have a plan. It is a bad plan. I love it.
Step one: we go in. Step two: … there is no step two.
Trust me. I am almost a professional.
Mr. Flex is not so great. Sunglasses! At night!
I am NOT an orange dog. I am a ginger wizard.
I can flex too. … Ow. My back.
My name? Gary. Just Gary. Why? Who told you?
McFox– who? Never heard of him.
I knew that. I knew that before you knew that.
Ooh, shiny. No. Focus, Gary. … Ooh, shiny.
Write that down, detective. I would. I cannot write.
Dun-dun-dun-DAAA! … I do my own music.
One day they will say: Gary the Great. And I will say: yes.
It WORKED? IT WORKED! Did you see? Did EVERYBODY see?

text: Report, detective!
Detective! Stand up straight. Good. Now find my keys.
Nobody panic! That is an order!
Seven hundred years. Never late. Not on my watch!
Twenty minutes, detective. I am counting. I always count.
Rule number one: no running. I am not running. I am walking fast.
I do not panic. I panic in an orderly way.
Fun? We do not do fun here. We do duty.
Left, right, left, right. Thinking is like marching.
I never lose things. Things lose me.
Tea is at four. Trouble is never.
Where on earth is my hat?
Nobody touches my hat. Nobody.
My hat is not funny. It is a very serious hat.
FOX!
FOX! Take off that cape.
That is not magic. That is a door.
I am not clapping. I am keeping my hands warm.
I am not smiling. My face is cold.
I do not dance. … That is my foot. Not me.
That was a march. A very happy march.
Is that cake? No. Duty first. Cake second. … A small piece.
Good work. Do not tell anyone I said that.
Mrs Crumb! I … good evening … I must go.
I was never worried. My moustache was worried.
I was not humming. That was the wind.
When I was young, I was also … no. I was never young.
One, two, three … do NOT move, I am counting!
… You saw nothing.
Please.
